official_tagline: طلب واحد.. عرض واحد.. مناسبة أسهل

logo.note: Use as-is. Do not redraw, recolor, or regenerate the logo with AI.

colors.note: Two green systems exist: logo/partners deck use olive green #33650C, posters use deep green #005731. Owner must pick one before final renders. Until then use logo green #33650C with logo gold #CBA401.

fonts.arabic_brand: 29LT Bukra Wide (Regular/Bold) — used in partners deck. Commercial font from 29LT: do NOT embed or download unless the owner supplies licensed .ttf/.otf files.
fonts.fallback_until_licensed: Any open Arabic font the owner approves (e.g. Tajawal, IBM Plex Sans Arabic) — mark renders as draft.

links.note: Demo/staging site of the real platform. Use it to confirm the actual request flow and record real screen captures. Not the final public URL.
